(ORDER LIST:  609 U.S.) 
TUESDAY, SEPTEMBER 8, 2026 
ORDER IN PENDING CASE 
26A239 DOE, JANE V. McDONALD, COMM’R, ET AL. 
The application for injunction pending appeal presented to 
Justice Sotomayor and by her referred to the Court is denied. 
Justice Alito and Justice Gorsuch would grant the 
application.
